mapper.select: SELECT la.application_id AS applicationId, la.user_id AS userId, su.real_name AS userName, su.phone AS userPhone, lp.product_name AS productName, la.apply_amount AS applyAmount, la.apply_term AS applyTerm, la.credit_score AS creditScore, la.apply_time AS applyTime, la.contract_status AS contractStatus FROM loan_application la LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON la.user_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN loan_product lp ON la.product_id = lp.product_id WHERE la.application_status = 'pending' ORDER BY la.apply_time ASC

SELECT ar.application_id AS applicationId, ar.audit_result AS auditResult, CAST(ar.final_label AS SIGNED) AS finalLabel, ar.fraud_tag AS fraudTag, ar.reject_reason AS rejectReason, ar.audit_time AS auditTime, rdl.model_version AS modelVersion, rdl.scorecard_score AS scorecardScore, rdl.scorecard_decision AS scorecardDecision, rdl.feature_snapshot AS featureSnapshot FROM audit_record ar LEFT JOIN risk_decision_log rdl ON rdl.application_id = ar.application_id WHERE ar.final_label IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ar.audit_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
